label: TP
reason: User input from request header flows directly to response.getWriter().println() without proper sanitization. The param variable receives user-controlled data from request.getHeader(), undergoes URL decoding (which does not mitigate XSS), and is passed through doSomething() which assigns it to bar. At line 97, 'user' contains the concatenated input (including testCaseNumber derived from fullClassName) which is printed directly to response without escaping. Similarly at line 95, rememberMe.getName() outputs the cookie name containing user input. Both represent XSS sinks.
